tc.subtitle: 深度營運與策略研究｜2026 年第三季業績專題
tc.source_line: 更新：2026/10/15｜季度截至 2026/09/30｜業績公布：2026/10/14。實績取自公司披露；預測及估值為 Bloomberg EEO 截圖快照。

views.title: 監管和解費用之外，核心盈利仍需改善
views.text: 我們認為，US$1.2bn 不可扣稅監管和解費用是 GAAP EPS 降至 US$0.91 的重要原因，但不能因此忽略經營壓力。剔除該項後 EPS 為 US$1.08、淨利潤約 US$8.1bn，後者仍低於去年同期 US$8.332bn。調整後效率比率為 62%，高於去年 60%。監管費用消失可改善報表，持續盈利提升仍須依靠收入增長與成本紀律。

views.title: 淨利息收入與財富費用提供底盤
views.text: 我們認為，GAAP 淨利息收入年增 8% 至 US$16.449bn，與貸款、存款及固定利率資產重定價有關，是本季最穩定的增長來源。平均貸款年增 6%，各分部均增長；財富管理收入年增 13%，AUM 流入 US$20bn。惟市場交易及投行收入下降，令總收入只增 3%。要恢復較佳營運槓桿，需這些穩定來源與資本市場業務同時改善。

views.title: 信貸改善不等於可以忽略資本消耗
views.text: 我們認為，淨核銷率由去年 0.47% 降至 0.44%，信用卡核銷率降至 3.22%，支持當前資產品質仍可控。然而標準法 CET1 由上季 11.2% 降至 10.9%，同期向股東回饋約 US$8.3bn。資本分派應與貸款擴張、風險加權資產及潛在監管整改成本一併評估，不能僅憑本季信貸改善便提高長期回購假設。

views.title: 低本益比需要回報率修復配合
views.text: 我們認為，FY2027E 調整後本益比 9.89 倍、P/B 1.19 倍提供估值討論空間，但本季 公布 ROTCE 12.6%、調整後 14.9%，仍須與資本成本及風險一起看。ANR 共識目標價 US$65.35 相對 US$51.39 有 27.2% 價差，只是整體快照。個別投行欄列示 10/14 業績公布當日記錄；日期並不能確定其更新在公布前或後。

risks.title: 利率、存款與淨利息收入
risks.text: 資產重定價有利 NII，但存款定價、資金組合及利率曲線改變可能抵銷效益；平均存款本季較上季大致持平。

risks.text: FICC 收入年減 17%、投行費用減 11%；若客戶活動持續偏弱而科技、人員及合規投入增加，效率比率可能較難改善。

risks.text: 目前核銷率改善仍可能受就業、消費或商業信用惡化逆轉；CET1 降至 10.9%，進一步資本壓力可能限制回購。

views.title: 监管和解费用之外，核心盈利仍需改善
views.text: 我们认为，US$1.2bn 不可抵税监管和解费用是 GAAP EPS 降至 US$0.91 的重要原因，但不能因此忽略经营压力。剔除该项后 EPS 为 US$1.08、净利润约 US$8.1bn，后者仍低于去年同期 US$8.332bn。调整后效率比率为 62%，高于去年 60%。监管费用消失可改善报表，持续盈利提升仍须依靠收入增长与成本纪律。

views.title: 净利息收入与财富费用提供基础
views.text: 我们认为，GAAP 净利息收入同比增长 8% 至 US$16.449bn，与贷款、存款及固定利率资产重定价有关，是本季最稳定的增长来源。平均贷款同比增长 6%，各分部均增长；财富管理收入同比增长 13%，AUM 流入 US$20bn。但市场交易及投行收入下降，令总收入仅增长 3%。要恢复更好的经营杠杆，需这些稳定来源与资本市场业务同时改善。

views.title: 信贷改善不等于可以忽略资本消耗
views.text: 我们认为，净核销率由去年 0.47% 降至 0.44%，信用卡核销率降至 3.22%，支持当前资产质量仍可控。然而标准法 CET1 由上季 11.2% 降至 10.9%，同期向股东回馈约 US$8.3bn。资本分配应与贷款扩张、风险加权资产及潜在监管整改成本一并评估，不能仅凭本季信贷改善便提高长期回购假设。

views.title: 低市盈率需要回报率修复配合
views.text: 我们认为，FY2027E 调整后市盈率 9.89 倍、P/B 1.19 倍提供估值讨论空间，但本季 公布 ROTCE 12.6%、调整后 14.9%，仍须与资本成本及风险一起看。ANR 共识目标价 US$65.35 相对 US$51.39 有 27.2% 价差，只是整体快照。个别投行栏列示 10/14 业绩公布当日记录；日期并不能确定其更新在公布前或后。

en.subtitle: Operations & Strategy Research | 3Q2026 Earnings Special
en.source_line: Updated 15 October 2026 | Quarter ended 30 September 2026 | Results released 14 October 2026. Actuals are company reported; forecasts and valuation are supplied Bloomberg EEO snapshots.

views.title: Beyond the settlement charge, underlying earnings need improvement
views.text: We believe the US$1.2bn non-deductible regulatory settlement is a major reason GAAP EPS fell to US$0.91, but it should not obscure operating pressure. Excluding it, EPS was US$1.08 and net income about US$8.1bn, still below the prior-year US$8.332bn. Adjusted efficiency was 62%, versus 60% a year earlier. Removing the charge helps reported earnings; durable improvement still requires revenue growth and cost discipline.

views.title: Net interest income and wealth fees support the base
views.text: We believe 8% growth in GAAP net interest income to US$16.449bn provides an important earnings foundation, supported by lending, deposits and fixed-rate repricing. Average loans grew 6% across all segments; wealth revenue rose 13% with US$20bn of AUM inflows. Trading and investment-banking declines limited total revenue growth to 3%. Stronger operating leverage requires these recurring engines and capital-markets activity to improve together.

views.title: Better credit does not remove capital constraints
views.text: We believe the decline in net charge-offs from 0.47% to 0.44% of loans and a 3.22% card charge-off rate support manageable current credit quality. Yet standardized CET1 fell from 11.2% to 10.9%, while capital returns were approximately US$8.3bn. Distributions must be weighed against loan growth, risk-weighted assets and remediation costs. One quarter of improving credit does not justify a permanently higher repurchase assumption.

views.title: A lower multiple needs better returns to justify rerating
views.text: We believe FY2027E adjusted P/E of 9.89x and P/B of 1.19x warrant attention, but reported ROTCE of 12.6% and adjusted ROTCE of 14.9% must be assessed against capital costs and risk. The US$65.35 ANR target implies 27.2% price upside from US$51.39, but is a broad snapshot. Individual broker cards show 14 October announcement-day records; their dates do not establish whether they were updated before or after the release.

risks.title: Regulatory remediation and legal costs
risks.text: The US$1.2bn charge relates to BSA/AML and sanctions compliance orders. Ongoing remediation may raise costs or constrain activity; it cannot be assumed that every related effect is finished.

risks.title: Rates, deposits and net interest income
risks.text: Asset repricing supports NII, but deposit pricing, funding mix and the yield curve can offset the benefit. Average deposits were broadly flat sequentially.

risks.title: Markets revenue and sticky costs
risks.text: FICC revenue fell 17% and investment-banking fees 11%. Weak client activity alongside technology, staffing and compliance investment could delay efficiency gains.

risks.title: Credit deterioration and distributions
risks.text: Improving charge-offs can reverse if employment, consumption or commercial credit weakens. CET1 of 10.9% leaves repurchases sensitive to further capital pressure.
